_doc: Per-ticker overrides. logos_enabled: global wheel-card artwork (Logo.dev + hand SVGs); false = ticker letters only. Per-ticker disable_logo forces letters. brand: hex overrides extracted colour. gradient: optional {frm,to,glow,kind} when brand hex alone is insufficient (e.g. near-black SpaceX). neutral: force graphite vs chromatic G1. letters_only: client shows ticker letters instead of the mark but keeps the shard brand gradient (build/seed ignore it; use instead of disable_logo, which re-seeds a hash-hue gradient).

SPCX.note: SpaceX black mark, black→dark grey gradient (G1 dark lift on frm)
